coordinate_rules.input: unmirrored normalized image xyz; world coordinates unused

sampling: causal processed source observations; no resampling; unprocessed frames only advance health clock
warmup: 32 consecutive valid observations, gap <= max_sampling_gap_ns; invalid resets count; after warmup retain short missing windows but current invalid disables ready
ready: warmed up and T=32 and current valid and history initialized and valid_ratio>=min_valid_ratio and span<=max_window_span_ns and age<=max_age_ns
reset: stream/track/context_epoch/timebase change or source/health gap > reset_gap_ns; duplicate/decreasing processed source times rejected
validation_status: Synthetic verification only; requires T04/T10 real/pilot data and validation before freezing thresholds.
